requirements.title: Processors may provide halting control with processor-dependent mechanics
requirements.definition: Some processors allow control over aborting or continuing after an exception through IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE; halting is imprecise after the exception, and the initial halting mode is processor dependent.

pending.halting-control-processor-permitted: No portable oracle requires halting control support. Capability plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW); supported branch exercises only halting .FALSE. get/set round trips, unsupported branch records skip.
pending.halting-occurrence-imprecise: No portable oracle fixes termination point or mechanism after a halting exception; fixture authors must not run with halting .TRUE. as a conformance expectation.
pending.initial-halting-mode-processor-dependent: No portable oracle fixes the initial halting mode. Future fixtures must set halting .FALSE. for a supported flag before observing preservation.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first, use conforming single-image programs, and assert only portable Clause 17 properties: named derived-type values, exact logical results, exact type/kind/rank characteristics, supported IEEE special-value classifications, exact representable arithmetic under the named support inquiry, or get/set round trips. Unsupported guarded branches are skips, not passes. Processor-dependent support availability, NaN payloads, exact halting mechanics, initial modes, approximation latitude, and IOMSG text are not asserted.

requirements.title: Procedures preserve halting mode except the halting and status setters
requirements.definition: A procedure other than IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE or IEEE_SET_STATUS does not change the halting mode on entry and ensures the same halting mode on return.

pending.procedure-entry-preserves-halting-mode: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW); supported branch sets halting .FALSE., calls IEEE_GET_FLAG on IEEE_OVERFLOW, then asserts IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE still returns .FALSE.; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.procedure-return-restores-halting-mode: Guarded branch plan: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW); supported branch sets halting .FALSE., calls an IEEE_EXCEPTIONS procedure other than IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE or IEEE_SET_STATUS, and asserts the post-call halting mode equals the pre-call mode; unsupported branch records skip.

accounting.rationale: Mixed processor latitude and halting-mode preservation are split into fine units.
Processor support for halting control is permitted, not required.
Halting timing after an exception is processor latitude.
The initial halting mode is processor dependent.

review_rationale: Source registration for 17.6-17.10, 17.11, 17.11.1 and 17.11.2: halting, floating-point modes and status, exceptional values, IEEE arithmetic, the procedure summary and general rules, and IEEE_CLASS (batch214). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; every IEEE effect is a guarded branch plan keyed to its own support inquiry, with exact 60559 results for infinity and subnormal operands. Source accounting only.
